app_type: hybrid_fullstack desktop companion (Tauri shell + React frontend)

surface_strategies.companion_surface: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)] rounded-2xl

grids_and_layouts.mode: Compact Bento Grid for Settings/Status, Floating Widget for Desktop Companion
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6) with smooth rounded corners

motion.transitions: Spring physics for avatar states, smooth fade for panels, hover scale micro-interactions

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AA compliant text over dark translucent surfaces
accessibility.reduced_motion: Supported via prefers-reduced-motion media query equivalents
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements include data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully interactive desktop companion app with Tauri simulation shell + React frontend.
Implement transparent borderless always-on-top draggable window behavior.
Include 2D animated Robo state display (Idle, Focused, Paused, Thinking, Alert).
Include conservative context detection without screenshots/audio/keylogging (Active window title detection, system idle state, battery/CPU telemetry).
Implement tray controls simulation, pause/hide/focus mode toggles, and robust local settings storage.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: use deep slate-900 glassmorphic surfaces with neon green/blue telemetry accents.
Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards against translucent backdrops.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds on headers or menus with text underneath.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
